http_status_misreporting.issue: Two sources carry http_status 'ok' for URLs that were never fetched and are in fact 403 in this environment.
http_status_misreporting.corrected_http_status: 403 Forbidden at CONNECT, body never retrieved

source_type_mislabels.correct: local diagnostic endpoint; not an external source of any kind
source_type_mislabels.note: The prior researcher admitted labeling it primary_government 'only to satisfy the enum'. A consumer filtering on source_type=primary_government would ingest localhost telemetry as a government source. The enum needed extending, not abusing.

source_type_mislabels.correct: IANA reserved documentation domain used as a diagnostic control; not an aggregator

source_type_mislabels.url: all https://trumprx.gov/p/* product pages and both whitehouse.gov fact sheets
source_type_mislabels.correct: The URL is a primary government URL, but the EVIDENCE actually held is a search-index summary, which is secondary. Recording source_type by URL rather than by evidence actually obtained lets an unread page inherit primary standing.

verbatim_quote_field_abuse.issue: Every entry in eligibility_rules puts non-verbatim text in a field named verbatim_quote: a paraphrase of a search-index summary, with an editorial disclaimer appended INSIDE the quoted string.
verbatim_quote_field_abuse.example: "Wegovy pen injections are $199 per month for the first two monthly fills, then $349/month for 0.25mg, 0.5mg, 1mg, 1.7mg, or 2.4mg and $399/month for the 7.2mg dose -- INDEX-MEDIATED, NOT A DIRECT READ of trumprx.gov, which returned HTTP 403."
verbatim_quote_field_abuse.why_blocking: The string is not a quotation from trumprx.gov, yet occupies the field a renderer would treat as attributable quoted text, and it carries specific dollar figures. It is also substantively wrong: it attributes the $199 introductory price to all five dose strengths.

programmatic_access_inconsistency.issue: trumprx.gov pages are marked programmatic_access 'prohibited' while whitehouse.gov, hhs.gov and cms.gov pages with IDENTICAL evidence (403 at CONNECT, robots.txt never read, no terms read) are marked 'unclear'.
programmatic_access_inconsistency.assessment: The value 'prohibited' reads as a finding about the site's stance. The only established fact is a local egress denial. The prior researcher's own narrative concedes 'I have zero evidence about whether trumprx.gov blocks automated clients'. 'unclear' is the supportable value for all of them; the MANUAL-CURATION-ONLY operational conclusion can rest on absence-of-grant without asserting site prohibition.

conflict_labeling_errors.issue: Marked confidence 'conflicting' between $1,028 and $935 while simultaneously stating 'I found no sourced support for $935'. An unsupported number is not a competing claim; labeling it a conflict grants it evidentiary standing and inflates uncertainty.
conflict_labeling_errors.correct: confidence 'unverified', value null, with $935 recorded as an unsourced figure from the brief (plausibly a stale historical Ozempic WAC) rather than as a conflicting claim.

conflict_labeling_errors.issue: Presented as a 'FOUR-WAY CONFLICT' where $1,087 and $1,086.37 are the same figure at different rounding.
conflict_labeling_errors.correct: confidence 'conflicting' is right but the conflict is narrower than stated; value null.

what_held_up_under_attack: The egress-blockade diagnosis and its refutation of the naive 'trumprx.gov blocks bots' reading -- independently reproduced.
All values being null with confidence unverified -- correct and the only defensible outcome.
The two-monthly-fill limit on the $199 introductory price -- the central patient-safety finding; independently reproduced.
The whitehouse.gov fact sheet figures ($1,028 / $1,349 / $1,088 / $350 / $346 / $199 / $299) -- independently reproduced.
The average-versus-lowest-dose reading that dissolves the apparent $350-vs-$199 conflict -- independently corroborated, though stated with more certainty than an unreadable page supports.
Zepbound per-dose ladder genuinely not obtainable by index-mediated means -- I could not obtain it either.
Fixtures: all seven prior fixture files are valid JSON and contain no emoji.
